{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_arm = deduplicated_data[deduplicated_data['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Compute the number of patients in the treatment arm
n_treatment = len(treatment_arm)

# Print the fraction responded and the count
print(fraction_responded)
print(n_treatment)"}
